criteria.name: Identity and source-backed footprint
criteria.evidence: Raw Purdue BuildingShapes feature FID 274 names Purdue University Student Health Center (PUSH), address 601 Stadium Mall Drive. The 13-vertex outline is transformed with the project campus formula; build record area is 1204.48 m2.
criteria.finding: Strong identity and plan source match. The exterior photo independently corroborates the building appearance, though it is not a dimensioned footprint survey.

criteria.name: Position, orientation, and scale/dimensions
criteria.evidence: Reopened asset vertex bounds are [[-229.0678253173828, -172.65992736816406], [294.11651611328125, 364.8216552734375], [0.0, 14.630399703979492]]; recorded GIS boundary mismatch is 0.0291 m. The GIS ring establishes campus placement, orientation, and horizontal dimensions.
criteria.finding: Horizontal placement and footprint scale closely reproduce the authoritative feature. The project uses an approximate local geographic conversion rather than a surveyed campus CRS, so minor systematic position/scale error remains possible.

criteria.name: Height, floors, and roof form
criteria.evidence: GIS FID 274 reports NUM_LEVELS/CountOfFLO=5, floor elevations through F04, and Extrution=48 without documented units. Model height is an explicitly estimated 14.63 m based on 48 ft; the photo shows a red pitched roof and approximately three above-ground levels in the visible portion.
criteria.finding: Height and floor count are unresolved, not measured. The model uses a single fan-like hipped roof over the entire irregular footprint. The 2020 photo instead shows different roof heights and a low entrance wing adjoining the taller main block; that massing is absent.

criteria.name: Facade, entrances, and distinctive architecture
criteria.evidence: The Purdue 2020 photograph directly supports red brick, pale stone trim/bands, upper-story windows, a broad glazed entrance, medical emblem, and red tile roof. The model represents brick, repeated windows, bands, glazing, emblem, and red roof.
criteria.finding: The principal facade features are recognizable, but the model repeats small windows uniformly around the perimeter. The photo has larger, differently proportioned upper-story windows, a broad and detailed entrance, and a one-story entrance wing. The entrance wall was selected by longest edge rather than source orientation, and side/rear facades are unverified.

criteria.name: Modular export, portability, and complete evidence
criteria.evidence: Saved library collection check: True, 1 object(s), 1 mesh; 6 assigned material(s); unpacked external images: []. Reopen record: True. Evidence includes raw GIS and metadata, official map PDF, Purdue photo and page snapshots, source register, renders, build record, and reopen validation.
criteria.finding: Stable asset file, collection, and ID are preserved; the export is self-contained and the reopen check passes. The one-mesh export is portable, although the building's architectural parts are not separately editable. Source citations and stated uncertainty are unusually complete.

source_types: Purdue University / John Underwood, Purdue Today archive

findings: The footprint/placement model is well evidenced, but the architectural massing in the source photo has a tall main block and a lower entrance wing; the exported model has one continuous wall height and one simplified roof system.

The GIS floor/extrusion fields and visible story count do not establish a reliable measured height. Keep the height explicitly estimated until a dimensioned elevation or other authoritative vertical source is found.
The facade reference is one oblique image. Entrance orientation and facade rhythms on other sides remain unverified.
